outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic paired with raw western blot images; it contains no plotted averages requiring individual data points.
Bar charts show densitometry quantification derived from single blot images per antibody (no stated replicate averaging or error bars), so they are not summary statistics requiring individual points.
Panel C is a heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from this check.
Panel D consists of violin plots, which already display the full data distribution and are exempt from needing overlaid individual points.
Panel E bar charts report mean ± SD (n=4) with individual replicate data points overlaid as dots on each bar.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a scatterplot; scatterplots inherently show individual data points and are exempt from this check.
Panel H is a scatterplot of individual IP-MS experiments; scatterplots are exempt from this check.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot where each point already represents an individual sample; exempt from this check.
Panel J is a set of PCA scatterplots where each point already represents an individual sample; exempt from this check.
